name: core-mars-mimos
description: Mimos, the 2026 Mars College café and lounge as Gene corrected it (north up): an L of Mimos main (the west longitudinal section; its northern part a raised wooden floor at 0.53 m with the coffee counter on the west wall and the study table at the north wall, its southern part at ground level) and Mimos floor, the short southeast arm with flooring throughout, the honey sofa beneath the posters on its north wall and the low tea table near its south wall. The pallet racks between main and floor are pass-through; the northeast of the L is outdoors. Rear alcove door with a stair at the north; three risers from main south up to the raised floor. 3 rooms, 34 wall/solid colliders, 2 stairs. 3369 triangles. Licence: Mars College (Gene Kogan); campus CAD and the 2026 photographic recipe; private to this project. Source: V3 Mars 2026 campus (scene_7d4cac4a…glb, Codex Mars handover 2026-10-10, Gene's Oct 10 corrections).
